name: Conditional Contact Odds
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: How much one extra neighbour of type B changes the odds a cell is type A, holding every other type's neighbour count fixed.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help: Selects the annotation used to define the groups.

params.name: k
params.label: Neighbours (k)
params.help: Sets the number of nearest neighbours considered for each cell. Larger values include a broader neighbourhood but increase runtime.

params.name: lam
params.label: Ridge
params.help: Controls how strongly coefficients are pulled toward zero. Higher values give more stable but more strongly smoothed estimates.

params.name: min_cells
params.label: Minimum cells per level
params.help: Groups with fewer cells are not shown but remain included in the model.

params.name: max_levels
params.label: Level ceiling
params.help: Stops the analysis if the selected annotation contains more groups than this, limiting runtime and matrix size.

params.name: gtol
params.label: Convergence
params.help: Sets when the model stops fitting. Smaller values require closer convergence but may take longer.
